commands: # host: ubuntu@EC2 (8 vCPU, 30 GB RAM, Ubuntu 26.04, gcc 15.2.0, python 3.14); same recipe passed on RHEL8 + gcc 13.2 + python 3.12
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake bison flex libreadline-dev python3-venv python3-dev git
git clone --branch 9.0.2 --recurse-submodules https://github.com/neuronsimulator/nrn nrn-9.0.2  # HEAD ba5783378c0aa1d9ac95b4454bea94b15c63f75d
python3 -m venv venv && pip install numpy 'cython<3.1' pytest plotly matplotlib anywidget

cmake $SRC -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DNRN_ENABLE_INTERVIEWS=OFF -DNRN_ENABLE_MPI=OFF -DNRN_ENABLE_RX3D=ON -DNRN_ENABLE_CORENEURON=OFF -DNRN_ENABLE_TESTS=ON -DNRN_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_TESTS=OFF -DNMODL_ENABLE_PYTHON_BINDINGS=OFF -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$VENV/bin/python3  # 7 s on EC2 local disk, 55 s on cluster NFS
cmake --build . --parallel 8 --target install  # 142 s on 8 cores; 114 s on 16 cluster cores
export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:$PATH; export PYTHONPATH=$PREFIX/lib/python; python3 -c 'import neuron'  # prints 9.0.2
pitfalls: Cython >= 3.1 crashes compiling share/lib/python/neuron/rxd/geometry3d/ctng.pyx ('Compiler crash in MarkParallelAssignments, AssertionError: <NOT CONSTANT>' with Cython 3.3.0); pin cython<3.1 (3.0.12 works)
NMODL_ENABLE_PYTHON_BINDINGS must stay OFF: compiling the bindings exhausts RAM

-DNRN_ENABLE_TESTS=ON does FetchContent at configure time: it needs network AND clones 5 test repos INTO the source tree at external/tests/ (nrntest, ringtest, reduced_dentate, testcorenrn, tqperf), so a tests-enabled configure dirties the checkout; build from a copy
capture the build exit code directly; piping the build through tail/tee and reading $? reports the pipe's exit and can hide a failed compile
the install is not relocatable and nrnivmodl needs a C compiler at runtime

landscape.notes: interpreter startup and embedding matrix (nrniv -python, python -c import neuron, ...); assert-based
HOC + Python API tests; several compare against JSON/dat expectations shipped in the test dir
builds and smoke-runs the shipped NMODL example mechanisms via nrnivmodl
NMODL translator behavior (incl. paths with spaces)
units checker on shipped mod files (hh, pattern, rand, stim, unitstest)
MPI-disabled init paths still tested without mpiexec

landscape.how_to_run: ctest -R 'rxdmod_tests' (one ctest entry running 129 pytest tests)
landscape.notes: reaction-diffusion; compares against stored arrays in test/rxd/testdata (47 MB)

landscape.how_to_run: ctest -R '^external_nrntest' (one entry, ~90 HOC decks via cmpdatfile)
landscape.notes: historical nrntest repo, fetched at configure into external/tests/nrntest; each deck compared byte-wise to a shipped .cmp file
runs in NEURON-only mode when CoreNEURON is OFF

runs.reproduced: 195 of 196 ctest entries pass on EC2 (gcc 15.2); the 1 failure is a reference mismatch detailed in run external-nrntest. Same suite on RHEL8 + gcc 13.2: external_nrntest passes, 196/196 counting both hosts.
runs.nondeterminism: none observed across 2 hosts except the CONDUCTANCE deck below

runs.reproduced: yes: 129/129 pytest tests pass against the stored arrays in test/rxd/testdata (upstream's own comparison)
pitfalls: needs plotly, matplotlib AND anywidget in the python env; a missing plotly or matplotlib fails ALL 129 tests at pytest collection, missing anywidget fails test_pltvar

runs.reproduced: no: 1 of ~90 HOC decks (nmodl/CONDUCTANCE/test.hoc) differs from its shipped .cmp reference on gcc 15.2/Ubuntu 26.04 (an integer flag on line 2 reads 0 instead of 1); all decks including this one pass byte-identically on gcc 13.2/RHEL8. Comparison is bytewise (cmpdatfile), so these decks are compiler-sensitive.
outputs: *.temp result files written next to each deck under external/tests/nrntest
pitfalls: the deck runner writes .temp files into the fetched external/tests tree inside the source checkout

runs.reproduced: yes: upstream's own JSON/dat comparisons pass (39/39)

pitfalls: nrnivmodl needs a working C compiler at test time

runs.reproduced: no reference (assert-based; passes in NEURON-only mode)
yes: spike raster matches the shipped reference (upstream comparison)
yes where a reference exists (connect_dend .ref, ringtest raster), no reference for the rest; all pass

pitfalls.symptom: Cython 3.3.0: 'Compiler crash in MarkParallelAssignments' on rxd geometry3d/ctng.pyx
pitfalls.workaround: pin cython<3.1 in the build env

pitfalls.symptom: all 129 rxd tests fail at pytest collection with ModuleNotFoundError (plotly, then matplotlib), and test_pltvar fails with 'Please install anywidget'
pitfalls.workaround: pip install plotly matplotlib anywidget before running the suite

pitfalls.symptom: configure with NRN_ENABLE_TESTS=ON needs network (FetchContent of 5 GitHub test repos) and clones them into external/tests/ INSIDE the source tree
pitfalls.workaround: build from a disposable copy of the checkout; pre-clone and set FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_<NAME> on offline machines

pitfalls.symptom: bytewise .cmp comparison fails on one deck (nmodl/CONDUCTANCE) under gcc 15.2 while passing under gcc 13.2
pitfalls.workaround: treat old nrntest decks as compiler-sensitive; pin the toolchain or exclude bytewise decks from cross-platform checks

pitfalls.symptom: python version drift changes nothing observable: suite passes on python 3.12.5 and 3.14

not_run.why: NRN_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_TESTS=OFF in this build; benchmarks are not correctness tests

not_run.what: MPI-dependent tests (test/parallel_tests, gjtests, music_tests, mpiexec variants)
CoreNEURON/GPU test variants and external suites testcorenrn, tqperf, reduced_dentate, olfactory-bulb-3d, channel-benchmark
not_run.why: NRN_ENABLE_CORENEURON=OFF (CPU-only headless build); these decks target the CoreNEURON backend or are long benchmarks
